recipes.title: Chicken tinga tacos
recipes.html:
Ingredients

  • 2 lb chicken thighs
  • 1 onion, sliced
  • 3 garlic cloves
  • 1 can (14 oz) fire-roasted tomatoes
  • 2 chipotles in adobo
  • Corn tortillas

Steps

  1. Simmer the chicken until tender, about 25 minutes. Shred.
  2. Soften the onion, add garlic.
  3. Blend tomatoes and chipotles; simmer 5 minutes.
  4. Fold in the chicken and serve on warm tortillas.
